blocks.title: Lattice energy
blocks.text: Ionic crystal ki lattice energy, delta Hlatt, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab standard halaat ke tehat gaseous ions se ionic compound ka ek mole bane: Na+(g) + Cl-(g) se NaCl(s), delta Hlatt = -787 kJ fi mol.
Lattice energy par asar karne wale awamil

Lattice energy ions par charge aur ions ke size par munhasir hai. Cation ya anion ka size barhne se lattice energy ghatti hai, kyunke mukhalif charge wale ions ki bharai kam tang hoti hai; alkali metal halides ki lattice energies LiF se CsI ki taraf girti hain. Lattice energy ions ke charges ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai. Lithium fluoride aur magnesium oxide mein ions ki tarteeb ek jaisi aur ions ke size milte-julte hain, magar MgO ki delta Hlatt = -3923 kJ fi mol hai LiF ke -1049 ke muqable: dugne charge wale Mg2+ aur O2- ions ek doosre ko usi size ke ikehre charge wale ions se kahin zor se khinchte hain. Milte-julte size ke ions ke liye jitna zyada charge utni zyada charge density aur utne mazboot ionic bonds.

blocks.alt: Lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium aur caesium ke halides ki lattice enthalpy (kJ/mol) ka graph, har lakeer fluoride, chloride, bromide aur iodide se guzarti hai. Har lakeer F- se I- tak kam manfi hoti hai, aur lakeerein Li+ se Cs+ tak oopar aati hain: LiF taqreeban -1036 se CsI taqreeban -604 kJ/mol tak.

blocks.text: Group 2 hydroxides aur sulfates ke solubility rujhanat

Delta Hsol lattice energy aur hydration enthalpy dono par munhasir hai. Group 2 mein neeche hydration energy aur lattice enthalpy dono ghatti hain, kyunke cations ki charge density girti hai. Hydroxides ke liye lattice energy Mg(OH)2, Ca(OH)2, Sr(OH)2 aur Ba(OH)2 mein Mg2+, Ca2+, Sr2+ aur Ba2+ ki hydration energy se tezi se ghatti hai, to lattice energy ghalib hai, delta Hsol zyada exothermic hota hai aur solubility barhti hai. Sulfates ke liye sulfate ion hydroxide se kahin bara hai, to MgSO4 se BaSO4 tak lattice energy ki kami kam hai, jabke cation ki hydration energy zyada miqdar se girti hai; ab hydration ghalib hai, delta Hsol zyada endothermic hota hai aur solubility MgSO4 se BaSO4 tak ghatti hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke ionic compound ki lattice enthalpy bari manfi qeemat kyun hai, aur BaSO4 MgSO4 se kam halne wala kyun hai jabke Ba(OH)2 Mg(OH)2 se zyada halne wala.
blocks.explanation: Lattice banne mein mukhalif charge wale ions door se qareeb, ba-tarteeb rabte mein aate hain, to bohat zyada electrostatic energy kharij hoti hai. Chhote hydroxide ion ke saath lattice energy group mein neeche tezi se girti hai jabke hydration kam girti hai, to halna asaan hota hai aur solubility barhti hai; bare sulfate ion ke saath lattice energy kam badalti hai, bare cations ki girti hydration energy ghalib hoti hai, aur solubility girti hai.

items: Lattice energy: gaseous ions se ionic solid ka ek mole (NaCl -787 kJ fi mol); bare ions ke liye chhoti, zyada charge ke liye kahin bari (MgO -3923 banam LiF -1049).
Group 2: hydroxides group mein neeche zyada halne wale (lattice energy tez girti hai), sulfates kam halne wale (hydration energy tez girti hai).
